title: Theme 3: Prediction and Profile of Rising Stars
Project Proposal
text:
The project topic will be based on VAST Challenge 2025. We have chosen Mini-Challenge 1.
VAST Challenge 2025 Mini Challenge 1 centres on the rise of Sailor Shift, a musician from the island nation of Oceanus. She’s famous for spreading the influence of the Oceanus Folk genre and frequently collaborating with lesser-known artists.
Silas Reed, a local journalist, has assembled a knowledge graph (MC1_graph.json) encompassing artists, albums, songs, collaborations, and influence relationships spanning decades. The result is a directed multigraph of 17,412 nodes and 37,857 edges spanning five node types and twelve relationship types. 
The challenge presents a rich but complex network dataset for us to uncover the structural patterns in how Sailor rose to fame, who she influenced, and how Oceanus Folk spread globally. Our project thus aims to build an interactive visual analytics dashboard that helps users trace Sailor Shift’s career, understand how Oceanus Folk spread and evolved, and identify the next likely breakout artists in the genre.

title: Project Proposal
text:
3.2 Edge Types



Edge Type
Description




PerformerOf
Indicates a that the source node (Person or MusicalGroup) performed the destination node (Song or Album)


ComposerOf
Indicates that the source node (Person) composed the destination node (Song or Album)


ProducerOf
Indicates that the source node (Person or RecordLabel) participated in the production of the destination node’s work (Song, Album, Person, or MusicalGroup)


LyricistOf
Indicates that the source node (Person) wrote lyrics for the destination node (Song or Album)


RecordedBy
Indicates that the destination node (RecordLabel) aided in the recording process for the source node (Song or Album)


DistributedBy
Indicates that the destination node (RecordLabel) aided in the distribution process for the source node (Song or Album)


InStyleOf
Indicates that the source node (Song or Album) was performed at least partly in the style of the destination node (Song, Album, Person, or MusicalGroup)


InterpolatesFrom
Indicates that the source node (Song or Album) interpolated a melody from the destination node (Song or Album).


CoverOf
Indicates that the source node (Song or Album) is a cover of the destination node (Song or Album)


LyricalReferenceTo
Indicates that the source node (Song or Album) makes a lyrical reference to the destination node (Song or Album)


DirectlySamples
Indicates that the source node (Song or Album) consists of (an) audio recording(s) that directly reuse a portion of the audio recording of the destination node (Song or Album) via sampling


MemberOf
Indicates that the source node (Person) is (or was) a member of the destination node (MusicalGroup)



Note on “Influence”: In this project, ‘Influence’ will refer to any direct or indirect relationship where a source node incorporates elements from a destination node through stylistic (InStyleOf), musical (InterpolatesFrom), lyrical (LyricalReferenceTo), audio-sampling (DirectlySamples). A cover (CoverOf) will also be treated as a form of influence, where the source work is a reinterpretation of the destination work.

title: Project Proposal
text:
4.1 Scope of Work
Theme 1: Sailor Shift Career Profile
We will develop dashboards reconstructing Sailor Shift’s artistic trajectory through time, emphasising incoming influences, collaborator relationships, and downstream impact on the Oceanus Folk community. This will require deriving Sailor-linked works, collaborator networks, and direct and indirect influence pathways.
Theme 2: Spread of Oceanus Folk Genre
We will analyse how Oceanus Folk propagated through the graph by tracing influence edges, genre transitions, and prominent artists associated with the genre, identifying whether the spread of Oceanus Folk was steady or episodic, and which external genres now shape its contemporary form.
Theme 3: Prediction and Profile of Rising Stars
We will build an artist comparison and prediction component that identifies emerging Oceanus Folk artists based on structural and temporal indicators such as collaboration breadth, influence growth, and genre reach, visualising what a rising-star trajectory looks like in comparison with established artists.

title: Project Proposal
text:
4.2 Planned Visualisations
The final Tableau application will consist of several coordinated dashboards.
For Theme 1, we plan a Sailor Shift career dashboard combining a release timeline, incoming influence analysis, and collaborator network.
For Theme 2, we plan dashboards showing genre diffusion, top influenced genres and artists, and changing influence into Oceanus Folk over time.
For Theme 3, we plan an artist comparison dashboard and a rising-star prediction dashboard supported by derived metrics and annotated justifications.

title: Project Proposal

We have done a initial extraction of Sailor Shift’s network graph in Gephi, which we intend to explore further in order to examine the relationships surrounding her.
